draft.internal_note: Customer asked if Ridgeline Pour-Over Kettle works on induction cooktops. Catalog states it is NOT compatible with induction. Provide clear answer.
draft.reply:
Hi Noah,

Thanks for reaching out! The Ridgeline Pour-Over Kettle is not compatible with induction cooktops. It works on gas burners, electric coil stoves, and camp stoves.

If you have any other questions, feel free to ask.
